name: Triple stress, macro-armed: extreme-fear + funding flush + risk-off regime cross (large-cap BTC/ETH)
rationale: Thesis: the highest-conviction mean-reversion bottom is sentiment + leverage capitulation that fires PRECISELY as the macro regime is rolling over into risk-off (the forced-selling window). Restrict to the two deepest-liquidity names (BTC/ETH proxy via min_instruments) where capitulation prints are cleanest and slippage smallest. Entries require fear_greed extreme-low AND funding_rate flushed (perp longs liquidated) AND macro_regime crossing DOWN (the stress is hitting the composite, not yet bottomed). macro_regime is drifting so it is used ONLY via cross_down. Long-only spot, medium hold. Disconfirmer: must beat the SAME triple stripped of the regime arm (i.e. fear+funding pair) on this subset after fees; if the pair matches, the regime cross adds no timing value and is noise. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: extreme fear and a funding flush coinciding with macro_regime rolling into risk-off
